title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 34: Moses sees the land from Mount Nebo, dies in Moab, and Joshua takes his place.

questions.text: Moses went up to Mount Nebo, to the top of what?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, opposite Jericho.

questions.text: Yahweh showed Moses all the land of Judah as far as which sea?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says Yahweh showed him all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea.

questions.text: How is Jericho described in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 speaks of the Plain of the valley of Jericho, "the city of palm trees," to Zoar.

answers.text: The city of the great king

questions.text: What did Yahweh say Moses would not do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there."

answers.text: See the land with his eyes
Return to the plains of Moab

questions.explanation: Verse 5 says Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh's word.

questions.text: What does the text say about Moses' tomb?
questions.explanation: He was buried in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

answers.text: No man knows where it is to this day
It is beside the Jordan at Gilgal
It is in a cave near Hebron
Joshua built it on Mount Nebo

questions.text: What was true of Moses when he died at one hundred twenty years old?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone."

answers.text: He was blind and could not walk
His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone
He had been sick for many days

questions.text: How long did the children of Israel weep for Moses in the plains of Moab?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days.

questions.text: Why was Joshua full of the spirit of wisdom?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says Joshua was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him.

answers.text: Moses had laid his hands on him
He had fasted for forty days
He had spent a night in the Tent of Meeting
The priests had anointed him with oil

questions.text: How did Yahweh know Moses, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says no prophet has arisen in Israel like Moses, "whom Yahweh knew face to face."

answers.text: By the voice of an angel
